scope: Independent acceptance checks of actual native outputs; not physiological efficacy or deployed browser certification.

inputReviews.detail: Exact event dates and horizon reuse the historical PDF calendar. The original user supplied relative times.
Training days reuse the historical PDF calendar; all 90-minute weekday caps and 240-minute Sunday caps are new explicit comparison assumptions, not athlete facts.
Training age is an explicit comparison assumption; first competition is not proof of lifting inexperience.
Current scalar mileage uses the prior PDF provisional assumption (30 km or midpoint45 km); no six-week history or long-run recovery data is invented.
The previous marathon is placed on25October solely to make the historical first recovery week executable; exact completion date was not provided.
Confirm recent long-run distance and recovery before extending the endurance-support long run; a past marathon does not establish present long-run readiness.
Confirm recent long-run distance, duration and recovery before approving marathon long-run progression.

Marathon endurance review: this specific block is not yet supported by substantial weekly mileage and long-run capacity. Review a completion-led run/walk approach, more suitable availability or the race date.

gates.detail: Week 1: 3 actual training runs; athlete requests 3.
Week 1: 3 strength visits; accepted scenario contract 3. Per-lift frequencies are separate mapping assumptions.
Training calendars must contain no unplaced components; a specific blocked event permission/time gate is retained as athlete-input review, not silently approved.
Incomplete calendars must remain explicitly blocked, not exported as accepted programmes.
Source minute caps require auditable inclusive session budgets; no run-only estimate or unsupported mapping is a pass.
After the first event and recovery gate, the calendar must visibly adopt the next sport priority and running frequency.
No automatic long run the day after strength event 2027-01-23.
Event 2027-05-02: native upper duration 317 min, confirmed window explicitly uncapped min; unresolved extension must be specifically blocked.
7 actual scheduled event-rhythm rehearsals before the final race week; current-fitness pacing is required.
Three weekly bench exposures must express distinct heavy, volume and speed doses where the preparation allows them.
Recovered experienced athletes need meaningful heavy rehearsals approaching competition, with RPE governing load and no forced maximum/grind.
